_metadata.description: A readable, editable, uncertainty-bearing preference model over frozen embeddings.

requirements.title: The model returns preference and uncertainty together
requirements.description: The preference model yields both an expected preference and a calibrated uncertainty at any point in the embedding space. Uncertainty is a first-class output because informative pair selection, honest exploration, and truthful explanation all depend on it; a point-estimate model cannot satisfy the dependent requirements.

validation.notes: Scoring returns mean and variance; variance rises with distance from observed data

requirements.title: Unheard and just-generated tracks are scorable
requirements.description: Because the model is defined over the embedding space rather than over item identities, a track with no interaction history — including one generated seconds ago — receives a preference estimate and an uncertainty without any cold-start special case.

validation.notes: A never-seen track scores without special-casing

requirements.title: The profile is a readable, editable surface
requirements.description: The listener can see what the model believes about their taste, how confident it is, and which attributes carry the most weight; and can directly pin, boost, or ban any attribute. Edits take effect immediately and are distinguishable from learned belief.

validation.notes: Manual constraints apply immediately and remain separable from learned weights
Profile renders belief, confidence, and attribute weights

requirements.title: Taste adapts in days, not seasons
requirements.description: Recent evidence is weighted so a genuinely new interest moves recommendations within days rather than being regularised away as noise against years of history. A sustained shift is distinguished from incidental variation.

validation.notes: A sustained new-interest signal shifts rankings within a bounded number of sessions

requirements.title: Context-scoped profiles
requirements.description: Distinct listening contexts carry distinct preference profiles so that incompatible tastes are not averaged into a meaningless middle, with the active context selectable and inferable.

validation.notes: Per-context profiles score the same track differently
